kpis.signal: 85% du CA Carrier, croissance +26% FY24 portee par integration Viessmann Climate Solutions (acquisition janvier 2024)
kpis.description_fr: CA segment HVAC FY24 incluant integration Viessmann Climate Solutions (acq janvier 2024). Marques: Carrier, Toshiba, Automated Logic, Bryant, CIAT, Day & Night, Heil, NORESCO, Riello, Viessmann. ~85% du CA total.
kpis.description_en: HVAC segment revenue FY24 including Viessmann Climate Solutions integration (acq January 2024). Brands: Carrier, Toshiba, Automated Logic, Bryant, CIAT, Day & Night, Heil, NORESCO, Riello, Viessmann. ~85% of total revenue.

kpis.signal: Segment Transicold (transport refrigeration) en contraction cyclique 4 annees consecutives, recovery attendue avec normalisation truck/trailer cycle
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Refrigeration FY24 (transport refrigeration et monitoring pour camions, remorques, navires). Contraction cyclique continue depuis FY21. Marque Carrier Transicold.
kpis.description_en: Refrigeration segment revenue FY24 (transport refrigeration and monitoring for trucks, trailers, ships). Continued cyclical contraction since FY21. Carrier Transicold brand.

kpis.signal: Compression severe FY24 due a backlog/intangible amortization Viessmann (-260 bps gross margin), recuperation attendue avec synergies
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle segment HVAC FY24, compression a 12.1% (vs 15.0% FY23) due a backlog amortization et intangible amortization Viessmann ($834 M FY24). Impact -260 bps gross margin.
kpis.description_en: HVAC segment operating margin FY24, compressed to 12.1% (vs 15.0% FY23) due to Viessmann backlog and intangible amortization ($834M FY24). -260 bps gross margin impact.

kpis.signal: Expansion spectaculaire +940 bps grace mix favorable, restructuring, pricing discipline, masque baisse CA
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle segment Refrigeration FY24, expansion +940 bps a 20.6% vs 11.2% FY23. Profit segment $715M FY24 vs $428M FY23 (+67%) malgre CA -9%. Mix favorable container/marine + restructuring.
kpis.description_en: Refrigeration segment operating margin FY24, +940 bps expansion to 20.6% vs 11.2% FY23. Segment profit $715M FY24 vs $428M FY23 (+67%) despite revenue -9%. Favorable container/marine mix + restructuring.

kpis.signal: CA Service recurring (HVAC + Refrig), levier strategique pour recurring revenue, modernization, monitoring abonnement
kpis.description_fr: CA total Service aftermarket FY24 (HVAC Service $2,092M + Refrigeration Service $414M). Composante recurring strategique: maintenance, monitoring, modernization, upgrades cycle de vie produit.
kpis.description_en: Total aftermarket Service revenue FY24 (HVAC Service $2,092M + Refrigeration Service $414M). Strategic recurring component: maintenance, monitoring, modernization, lifecycle upgrades.
